jobs.title: Python Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
We’re Hiring at CGI for our GCC \- Right Here in Hyderabad!
  

Join us at the intersection of technology, finance, and innovation. You will be working to support the Financial Services Group, one of the top\-tier financial institutions in the U.S. You’ll help shape digital solutions for a global enterprise—from the ground up.  

This is more than a job. It’s your opportunity to:  

* Work on cutting\-edge technologies
* Collaborate with global teams
* Build a career with purpose and impact


Ready to build the future of banking? Let’s talk.  

CGI is looking for a skilled Python Full Stack Developer with strong experience in Python, Django, FastAPI, REST APIs, Angular and/or React. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining scalable web applications across both backend and frontend layers.  

  

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with databases, APIs, authentication, cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices.  

Experience: 6 to 8 Years**Your future duties and responsibilities**


Key Responsibilities:  

  

Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Python, Django and FastAPI.  

Develop secure and high\-performance RESTful APIs and backend services.  

Build responsive and reusable frontend applications using Angular and/or React.  

Develop frontend components using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3\.  

Integrate frontend applications with Python\-based backend APIs.  

Design database schemas and develop efficient queries using PostgreSQL/MySQL.  

Work with ORM technologies such as Django ORM and SQLAlchemy.  

Implement authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth2 and role\-based access control.  

Develop asynchronous APIs and background processing where required.  

Write unit, integration, and API tests using PyTest/unittest and appropriate frontend testing frameworks.  

Debug application issues and perform performance optimization.  

Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, sprint planning, and technical design.  

Work with Git and modern CI/CD practices.  

Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment to cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure/GCP.  

Maintain technical documentation and follow clean\-code, SOLID, and secure\-development practices.  

Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and other developers.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Required Skills:  

  

Strong hands\-on experience in Python 3\.x  

Strong experience with Django  

Hands\-on experience with Django REST Framework (DRF)  

Strong experience with FastAPI  

Good understanding of RESTful API development  

Strong experience with Angular and/or React  

Good knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript  

Strong knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3  

Experience in integrating frontend applications with REST APIs  

Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases  

Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL / MySQL  

Experience with Django ORM / SQLAlchemy  

Good understanding of authentication and authorization, including JWT/OAuth2  

Experience with Git, GitHub/GitLab, and version control  

Good knowledge of unit testing and API testing using PyTest/unittest  

Experience with Docker and containerized applications  

Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines  

Knowledge of AWS / Azure / GCP is preferred  

Good understanding of microservices architecture  

Knowledge of Redis, Celery, Kafka/RabbitMQ is an added advantage  

Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming and design principles  

Good knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns  

Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments  

Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and analytical skills  

Good communication and collaboration skills

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

jobs.description:
Overview:

The Sr. Product Manager is responsible for acting as the “Voice of the Customer” for all stages and types of the Labs department initiatives, which may include researching and analyzing data, defining requirements, prioritizing features, and enhancements. The Sr. Product Manager typically reports to a Portfolio Director.


About Us:

When you join iCIMS, you join the team helping global companies transform business and the world through the power of talent. Our customers do amazing things: design rocket ships, create vaccines, deliver consumer goods globally, overnight, with a smile. As the Talent Cloud company, we empower these organizations to attract, engage, hire, and advance the right talent. We’re passionate about helping companies build a diverse, winning workforce and about building our home team. We're dedicated to fostering an inclusive, purpose\-driven, and innovative work environment where everyone belongs.


Responsibilities:
* Acts as an advocate for the customer and internal stakeholders as it relates to product issues and improvements
* Understands vision, direction and priority of the Product Backlog
* Identifies buy, build, or partner decisions to determine the optimal model for meeting market demands
* Define Product KPI’s to measure customer addition and product success.
* Define top level Epics and Product MVP that are aligned with business objectives for each feature in the roadmap plan.
* Liaise with Technical Product Manager and Engineering Managers. Clearly communicates business objectives and requirements for the assigned product requirements to drive delivery
* Prioritizes EPIC backlog and describes the product value to the Agile teams.
* Drives release planning. Coordinate with release management teams to define operational readiness plans for the product releases.
* Performs a variety of tasks including but not limited to functionality requirement documentation, customer beta programs, pricing analytics. Works with other departments in a cross functional environment
* Supports strategic sales opportunities and Labs partner program engagements
* Liaises with Product Marketing to ensure product positioning is effectively communicated
* Consistently ensures that business is always conducted with integrity and that behavior aligns with iCIMS policies, procedures, and values
* Demonstrates an inclusive people leadership \& team management skill.


Qualifications:
* 6\+ years of relevant product management experience
* Ability to set and manage priorities judiciously
* The desire to be part of and to contribute to a team environment
* Works under limited manager supervision. Exceptionally self\-motivated and creative.
* Strategic analysis/creative problem solving, business judgment and financial acumen are required.
* Expert knowledge and planning of multiple products. Demonstrated product lifecycle management abilities.
* Exceptional relationship building skills and the ability to strategically plan across all departments in the organization.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to convey thoughts and ideas across all levels of the organization
* Previous experience managing product business more than $50M annual revenue.
* Previous experience in managing local and\\or remote team of individual contributors.

  

**Education/Certifications/Licenses:*** Bachelors \\ Masters or equivalent in related field.


EEO Statement:

iCIMS is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at iCIMS. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you’d like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at careers@icims.com.


Compensation and Benefits:

Competitive health and wellness benefits include medical insurance (employee and dependent family members), personal accident and group term life insurance, bonding and parental leave, lifestyle spending account reimbursements, wellness services offerings, sick and casual/emergency days, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, retirals (PF \- employer contribution) and gratuity. We operate in a high\-accountability environment where marketing is measured by pipeline influence, deal acceleration, and revenue contribution, not vanity metrics.

* Solid understanding of B2B buyer journeys
* Hands\-on experience executing ABM programs
* Strong grasp of inbound marketing fundamentals

* Contribute to scalable processes within the agency for repeatable campaign success.
* Analytics, Reporting \& KPI Ownership

Track KPIs including:

* Pipeline influenced
* MQLs and SQLs
* Account engagement scores
* Conversion rates
* Cost per opportunity
* Revenue contribution
* Build dashboards using tools such as HubSpot, Looker Studio, DashThis, Airtable.
* Deliver strategic insights, not just reports.
* Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance data.

* Partner with Sales and RevOps to align messaging, lead qualification, and follow\-up strategies.
* Create enablement materials including pitch decks, persona\-based messaging, and campaign briefs.
* Support GTM planning for new offerings, product launches, and strategic initiatives.
* Ensure seamless marketing\-to\-sales handoff.
* Team Collaboration \& Project Management
* Collaborate with marketing team members across content, SEO, paid, and campaign functions.
* Drive accountability, quality, and timely project execution within your workstreams.
* Support multiple client accounts within a B2B agency structure.
* Manage project planning using structured trackers and project management systems.

Required Experience \& Skills

* 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, ABM, inbound, or demand generation roles.
* Track record of contributing to measurable pipeline and revenue impact.
* Working understanding of full\-funnel marketing architecture.
* Experience working with SaaS or technology clients preferred.
* Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot preferred).
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals and content\-led growth.
* Experience with LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, or retargeting campaigns.
* Strong analytical mindset with KPI ownership.

What We're Looking For

jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**About** **the** **Team**



The NR Lens team builds New Relic's Federated Data Platform — a distributed SQL query engine that lets customers connect external data sources (Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Google Sheets, AWS CloudWatch) and query them directly from New Relic.



You'll work on the distributed query execution layer, connector architecture, and API gateway that powers cross\-source JOINs and unified analytics across customer data stores.

  



**What** **You'll** **Do**


* Design, build, and maintain cloud\-native Java microservices in the NR Lens query path: SQL Gateway, Query Gateway, and data source connector plugins
* Develop and harden JDBC connector integrations — including connection lifecycle management, credential handling, query pushdown optimization, and security validation
* Improve query reliability and performance across a multi\-tenant distributed SQL deployment serving 50\+ customers
* Build and operate services on AWS (EKS, IAM/STS, S3\) with infrastructure\-as\-code practices
* Implement security controls for user\-supplied connection parameters (JDBC URL validation, SSRF prevention, hostname allowlisting)
* Build materialized view scheduling, execution, and lifecycle management features
* Design and implement deployment automation — canary deployments, progressive rollouts, observability integration
* Collaborate with the NRDB/Dirac team on the internal connector bridging federated queries to New Relic's native telemetry engine
* Participate in on\-call rotation and incident response for production systems


 **What** **We're** **Looking** **For**



**Must** **Have:**


* 5\+ years of professional Java development .
* Strong experience building cloud\-native applications on AWS.
* Experience designing and operating containerized microservices on Kubernetes
* Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale
* Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with AWS security patterns.
* Experience with observability tooling — defining SLOs/SLIs, dashboards, alerting
* Comfort debugging production issues across multi\-service architectures
* Experience with gRPC or Thrift\-based service communication
* Experience with GraphQL APIs


 **Nice** **to** **Have:**


* Strong understanding of SQL query execution — parsing, planning, optimization, or execution engines
* Experience with JDBC drivers, connection pooling, and database connector development
* Experience with distributed query engines or SQL\-on\-anything platforms

* Knowledge of RBAC/authorization systems in multi\-tenant SaaS environments

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon moves millions of packages every day through the world's largest transportation network of planes, trucks, and delivery vehicles. Before any package can be assigned to a route, someone needs to design that network \- figure out which lanes exist, how much capacity each node and lane can handle, and what changes are needed as demand shifts. That's what we build.  

Global Transportation Tech Services (GTTS) creates software that manages the foundation of Amazon's outbound transportation network. Your work has direct financial impact on network efficiency and directly affects whether customers get their packages on time.  

Here's what we actually do: We build the platform that transportation teams use to design and change the network \- from evaluating new lanes to implementing them in production. We calculate how much capacity each node and lane will have, so the network can handle the volume. We identify where capacity will fall short and alert operators before it becomes a problem. We spot packages at risk of missing delivery and give operators tools to protect them. When a hurricane hits Florida or a snowstorm shuts down highways in Germany, our systems detect the disruption, protect customers by adjusting delivery promises, and help move volume to keep packages flowing.  

The challenges are real: modeling capacity across a massive global network, managing thousands of network changes safely, predicting capacity gaps weeks in advance, detecting and responding to disruptions in real\-time, and keeping systems running 24/7\.  

We regularly build new greenfield products while also modernizing existing systems. You'll have space to explore new technologies and approaches to solve customer problems. We work with AWS services, big data processing (Spark/Scala), optimization algorithms, machine learning models, and GenAI.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a leader on the team, you will be expected to operate at all levels, diving deep into the details while providing strategic inputs for the product portfolio. You will be a key player in driving strategic planning, project execution, driving operational excellence, and shaping up the solutions to achieve our vision. This is your opportunity to make a big impact and make history in the world of Global Transportation!

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
* Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
* Experience with end to end product delivery

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. **Description**
 Amazon's travel, events, and expense programmes serve employees at an unprecedented scale, with a mission to deliver an employee\-centric experience that lets them be more productive, while also helping to manage costs, safety, and sustainability. Today that experience is fragmented across too many systems, partners, and manual processes. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to own the product strategy that consolidates these into a unified platform, dramatically reducing cost\-to\-serve while delivering a self\-service experience employees prefer over the alternatives.
   

  

 You'll partner with engineering, science, and design teams alongside third\-party partners to deliver intelligent automation, personalized experiences, and modern customer service capabilities. AI\-powered intelligent personalization and automation are tools in your toolkit, not the job description itself. You should be energized by applying them to genuinely eliminate friction, not just modernize the wrapper around legacy processes. This requires someone who takes ownership of ambiguous problems, makes hard build\-vs\-buy calls, and delivers measurable results at pace.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define product requirements for self\-service capabilities that reduce support contacts, eliminate manual work, and cut expense processing time.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI capabilities for knowledge orchestration, intelligent routing, and agentic automation, to deliver measurable product improvements.
* Collaborate with technical programme managers and engineering teams to translate product vision into high\-quality technical solutions
* Drive the product strategy for shifting from fragmented third\-party dependencies to first\-party platform ownership, informing build\-vs\-buy decisions that permanently restructure the cost base
* Lead and develop a team of product managers and analysts; hire bar\-raising talent
* Influence cross\-functional global teams across finance, HR, and workplace technology to resolve dependencies and deliver shared outcomes
* Partner with customer services teams to set new program\-level success metrics (adoption, cost\-to\-serve, customer satisfaction) and use data to drive prioritization
* Write compelling narratives, strategy documents, and business cases to contribute to executive alignment, investment, and cross\-organizational resourcing for transformation initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 Start with a backlog review with your team, sharpening acceptance criteria for a self\-service workflow that eliminates a manual handoff. Move to a design sprint with engineers where you're debating trade\-offs between two integration approaches and deciding which to prototype first. Progress with synthesizing customer feedback into a revised requirements doc, then pressure\-testing priorities with an existing third\-party partner. End the day with a quick check on adoption metrics from last month's release, turning what you learn into next sprint's input. You build first, then let the data tell you what to build next.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Amazon Travel \& Events exists to make every business trip and event seamless, safe, and cost\-effective for over 500,000 employees across 64 countries. Our Technology \& Data Solutions team is the builder behind that mission, designing the platforms and data capabilities that let employees plan, book, and manage travel and events and expense re\-imbursements with as little effort as possible. **Data Management Strategy \& Governance Advisor \- HIH \- Evernorth**

 **Position Overview**


The Data Steward is a highly visible member of a cross\-functional Data Product Enablement \& Governance team who partners with business, technical, and regulatory partners to ensure the documentation and implementation of data standards to ensure USE \& Care\+ analytic data is fit for organization use. This role focuses on governing the data and metadata foundations required to responsibly enable AI and advanced analytics, including business glossary management, data classification, metadata quality, and stewardship workflows for AI‑generated content. Working closely with data owners, product teams, analytics, engineering, and governance partners, this role ensures that data used for AI and analytics is accurate, compliant, explainable, and aligned to enterprise standards, while enabling scalable adoption of AI‑assisted metadata and automation capabilities across data products and platforms.


As a Data Steward, you’ll help define, govern, and enable trusted data products that power analytics, decision‑making, and AI—working across business and technical teams to make data clear, reliable, and valuable.

**Responsibilities**

* Govern data and metadata standards that ensures AI readiness, including semantic consistency, explainability, and reuse across AI and analytics use cases.
* Participate in the governance of AI‑generated metadata (e.g., glossary terms, descriptions, classifications), ensuring outputs are clearly labeled, reviewed, and approved through stewardship workflows.
* Ensure data used in AI and advanced analytics is appropriately classified, protected, and compliant with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Review and refine AI‑driven tagging rules (e.g., sensitivity labels, semantic classifications, glossary mappings) to ensure accuracy, explainability, and alignment with enterprise data standards.
* Lead Data Governance collaborations with USE \& Care\+ stakeholders to document, define, maintain, and manage foundational and analytic data and data assets.
* Expert on relevant data, data usage, data assets, and data landscape.
* Collaborate with other departments to ensure data standardization, consistency, and compliance across the matrixed USE \& Care\+ organization.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to establish data quality (DQ) metrics and determine performance standards.
* Partner with Enterprise Data Governance (EDG) to ensure end\-to\-end data governance and policy compliance.
* Identifies and addresses risks and vulnerabilities related to data security, compliance, usage, quality, and integrity across data assets.
* Provide consultative stewardship services to delivery and issue resolution teams, serving as subject matter expert as needed.
* Responsible for data quality assessment and monitoring; trends analysis; and remediation and preventative action coordination.
* Acts as a single point of contact for coordination of DQ initiatives for USE \& Care\+ data assets.
* Responsible for all Data Governance products within USE \& Care\+, including data rules, metadata management, CDE documentation, glossary, lineage, etc.
* Engages with Technical Product Owners (TPOs) and Capability Analysts (CAs) to provide input and feedback as appropriate.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills:**

* Knowledge of how data classification and tagging directly support AI enablement, including downstream impacts on access control, privacy, model training, and analytics reuse.
* Proven expertise in data model metadata (e.g., attribute definitions, lineage, source\-to\-target mappings) as an enabler for AI interpretability, semantic tagging, and governed reuse across analytics and AI use cases.
* Intermediate to Advanced data analysis skills and tools such as MS SQL (SSMS), Teradata, and MS Excel.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation).
* Ability to engage business and data stakeholders to resolve questions or issues.
* Ability to strategize across complex, cross\-functional projects and initiatives.
* Self\-driven with the ability to function with minimal direction.
* Ability to manage multiple and sometimes competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Quick learner and team player.

**Required Experience \& Education:**

* 5\+ years’ experience as a Data Steward.
* 5\+ years’ experience in the Healthcare industry.
* Experience in Agile methodology.

**Desired Experience:**

* Experience stewarding/supporting AI\-assisted data tagging, classification, or metadata enrichment capabilities, with accountability for business validation and governance approval of AI\-generated outputs.
* Experience with data governance tools, particularly Collibra DI and DQ.
* Experience with Commercial healthcare products.

**Work Hours:**

* 2\.30PM IST to 11\.30PM IST

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

*Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization\-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.*

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

As an Atlassian Platform Owner at Opella, you'll lead platform strategy, governance, reliability and adoption across Jira, Confluence and related apps. The Atlassian Platform Owner leads the vision, roadmap, and day\-to\-day operations of the Atlassian platform to enable modern, data\-driven delivery practices across the organization. Partnering with Agile Coaches, Atlassian Administrators, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and Business leaders, the Platform Owner ensures the platform is stable, scalable, secure, and aligned to agile best practices and business outcomes.

We’re looking for an AI \& Data Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business strategy, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. You will assist with performing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), the operationalization of business, process, and system changes, and driving data\-driven decisions through dashboard creation and AI\-powered insights across training curriculums, quality assurance, and reporting.

* Collect and validate data requirements for business intelligence and AI systems.
* Build, design, and maintain dynamic, executive\-facing dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to support reporting and visualize data from multiple applications.
* Identify AI opportunities and define business requirements to integrate Generative AI and machine learning solutions into existing operational workflows.
* Create, validate, and recommend optimization of business processes using data\-driven insights and AI capabilities.
* Support projects through development, quality assurance, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production implementation for both traditional software and data/AI models.

* Create internal guides, training materials, and end\-user documentation for new BI dashboards and AI features.
* Facilitate requirements workshops to connect business leaders with AI, data, and technical development teams.

* Demonstrated strength in communications (both verbal and written), with the ability to translate complex numerical data and AI concepts into a clear narrative that drives action.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and comfort with ambiguity when defining the scope of new data or AI projects.

jobs.description:
**Job Description – Product Manager – Direct Supplies \& Supply Chain**

**Role Overview**

The Product Manager – Direct Supplies \& Supply Chain will be responsible for managing Snackit’s Direct Supplies business along with product planning, procurement coordination, inventory, stock movement, expiry management, client requirements, pricing, margins, and business growth.

The role will involve managing the complete product lifecycle — from understanding client requirements and selecting the right products and brands, to procurement, stock planning, allocation, supply, monitoring product performance, controlling expiry and wastage, and ensuring profitable business growth.

The person will work closely with clients, suppliers, procurement, operations, finance, and internal teams to ensure the right product is available at the right location, at the right time, and at the right cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Product Management**

* Manage Snackit’s product portfolio across vending and Direct Supplies categories.
* Understand customer and client requirements and identify suitable products.
* Identify new products, brands, and categories based on market demand and client requirements.
* Develop and maintain the right product mix for different client locations.
* Identify high\-margin products and brands and drive their adoption where commercially suitable.
* Monitor product sales, demand, margins, and performance.
* Identify slow\-moving, low\-margin, and non\-performing products and take corrective action.
* Review product pricing regularly based on purchase cost, market conditions, client expectations, and target margins.
* Introduce new products and remove products that are not commercially viable.
* Work with suppliers and brands to improve product availability, pricing, schemes, and commercial terms.

**2\. Direct Supplies Management**

* Manage the complete Direct Supplies business for Snackit.
* Understand requirements of existing clients and identify opportunities for additional business.
* Meet new and existing clients to understand their pantry, snack, beverage, and other workplace supply requirements.
* Prepare product proposals and commercial quotations based on client requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, discounts, margins, and commercial terms with clients.
* Ensure that client requirements are fulfilled accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Develop long\-term client relationships and increase repeat business.
* Identify cross\-selling and upselling opportunities.
* Expand the range of products supplied to existing clients.
* Develop new business opportunities and contribute to Direct Supplies revenue growth.

**3\. Demand Planning \& Stock Planning**

* Forecast product requirements based on historical consumption, current orders, client requirements, and expected demand.
* Plan stock requirements for different client locations.
* Ensure adequate stock availability without unnecessary overstocking.
* Determine minimum and maximum stock levels for key products.
* Plan replenishment based on consumption and lead time.
* Monitor demand fluctuations and adjust stock plans accordingly.
* Coordinate with procurement and operations teams to ensure timely replenishment.
* Ensure stock is available at the right location based on actual business requirements.

**4\. Inventory Management**

* Monitor overall inventory levels across Snackit locations.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure proper stock tracking.
* Monitor fast\-moving, slow\-moving, and non\-moving inventory.
* Identify excess stock and plan movement or utilization to avoid inventory blockage.
* Monitor stock ageing and take timely action on ageing inventory.
* Plan stock transfers between locations based on demand.
* Ensure inventory is aligned with expected sales and client requirements.
* Minimize inventory holding costs while maintaining required service levels.

**5\. Expiry \& Wastage Management**

* Take ownership of product expiry management across all Direct Supplies and relevant inventory.
* Monitor expiry dates regularly and maintain an expiry tracking system.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable.
* Identify products approaching expiry and take timely action.
* Plan stock movement between locations based on expiry and demand.
* Prioritize products with shorter shelf life for consumption or supply.
* Coordinate with operations and clients to reduce expiry\-related losses.
* Analyse expiry and wastage trends and implement corrective measures.
* Minimize product expiry, damage, wastage, and inventory losses.

**6\. Supply Chain \& Procurement Coordination**

* Coordinate the complete supply chain from supplier to client/location.
* Work with procurement teams to ensure products are purchased at competitive prices.
* Plan purchases based on demand, stock levels, lead times, and client requirements.
* Coordinate with suppliers regarding availability, pricing, delivery schedules, schemes, and replacement of damaged/expired products where applicable.
* Identify alternate suppliers when required.
* Negotiate with suppliers to improve purchase costs and commercial terms.
* Ensure timely movement of products from warehouse/supplier to required locations.
* Identify supply\-chain gaps and recommend improvements.

**7\. Margin \& Commercial Management**

* Maintain target margins across products and clients.
* Analyse product\-wise and client\-wise profitability.
* Evaluate the impact of discounts before offering commercial terms to clients.
* Negotiate with clients to achieve commercially viable pricing.
* Negotiate with suppliers to improve purchase costs.
* Identify opportunities to improve gross margin through better product selection, pricing, supplier negotiations, and product mix.
* Monitor products with low or negative margins and take corrective action.
* Ensure business growth does not compromise profitability.

Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

jobs.title: Product Manager - User & Context Intelligence
jobs.description:
Glance runs an agent\-first consumer platform across surfaces: app, lockscreen, Connected TV, browser, OEM integrations, ecommerce embeds, and partner journeys. Almost every personalization, recommendation, generation, and agent experience depends on a shared understanding of who the user is and what they want. However, when each surface builds that understanding on its own, signals fragment, quality drifts, and the same user looks like a different person on every surface.
 



 We are looking for a Product Manager to own User \& Context Intelligence as a reusable capability: the product direction for how user, visual, behavioral, and commerce signals become durable intelligence attributes and a taste graph that other teams all consume through clear contracts.
 



 This role spans two tracks. The primary one is intelligence attributes and the taste graph: the reusable user\-understanding products that other teams build on. The secondary one is signal capture and instrumentation: making sure surfaces emit the right events, at the right freshness and confidence, so those attributes stay trustworthy.
 



**What you will own** 




**Intelligence attributes and taste graph** 



* The attribute catalog: reusable user attributes across style and visual preference, occasion affinity, brand and merchant affinity, price sensitivity, commerce intent, and habit stage, exposed as versioned products with clear input, output, freshness, and confidence contracts.
* The taste graph built from purchase\-proximal and engagement signals, served to personalization, recommendations, generation, and agent surfaces through a consistent interface rather than per\-surface rebuilds.
* Coverage and confidence as first\-class product concerns: attribute coverage across engagement\-depth tiers, confidence scoring, and refresh cadence, so every consumer knows what a signal means and how far to trust it.
* The user model lifecycle from a product view: what gets modeled, how attributes are validated, how quality and drift are tracked, and how weak supervision extends coverage to sparse and cold\-start users.



**Signal capture and instrumentation** 



* The signal contract: what user, visual, behavioral, and commerce signals Glance captures across surfaces, and the events, entities, and attributes schema behind them.
* Instrumentation designed for reuse across reporting, personalization, model training, experimentation, and intelligence synthesis, not wired to a single consumer.
* Identity stitching, data quality, lineage, discoverability, and feedback loops, so attributes stay accurate as surfaces and behavior change.
* Demand\-side clarity into Data Platform and ML Platform needs that matter to user intelligence: feature readiness, freshness, and serving requirements tied to real consumption from scientists, analysts, and surface teams.



**What we are looking for** 




 Must\-haves, in priority order:
 


* **User and preference modeling fluency.** 
 You understand how behavioral, visual, and commerce signals become durable user attributes and a taste graph, and how sparse, new, and cold\-start users are handled without guessing.
* **Signal and instrumentation design.** 
 You can define what to capture, at what granularity, freshness, and confidence, and design events for reuse across reporting, training, and personalization rather than for one surface.
* **Platform product thinking.** 
 You think in contracts, versioned attributes, coverage and confidence guarantees, adoption metrics, and consumption, so intelligence ships as products instead of one\-off pipelines.
* **Applied science/ data science partnership.** 
 You work deeply with Applied Science on attribute models, weak supervision, validation, and evaluation, and can hold a technical position and negotiate with senior ML and engineering without formal authority.
* **Adoption.** 
 You have a track record of getting surface and platform teams onto shared capabilities through workflow fit and clear contracts rather than mandates.
* **Spec quality.** 
 You turn an ambiguous problem into a PRD an engineer or scientist can build from: scope in and out, owners, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.
* **Judgment on the coverage\-precision trade\-off.** 
 You know when to extend an attribute to more users at lower confidence and when to hold the line, and you can defend the call.



**Background** 




 Strong product experience in one or more of: personalization, user modeling, customer data platforms, identity, recommendations, ML platforms, data platforms, or experimentation platforms. Direct experience owning a data\-backed or model\-backed product where attribute or signal quality was the core deliverable, ideally serving multiple internal consumers. Working understanding of feedback loops, cold start, weak supervision, and online and offline evaluation. Comfortable moving between technical and strategic registers, and crediting only what shipped.
 



 This is a high\-leverage role for someone who wants to build the user\-understanding layer that agent\-first experiences across many consumer surfaces depend on.

 Zoca is building the growth infrastructure that small beauty and wellness businesses have never had access to. Online visibility, bookings, payments, customer retention, voice AI. All of it, in one place, built to work without a full\-time marketing or ops team running it.

We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

You will build new search offerings to improve search quality for human users and scale up Search for agentic users, enabling them to intelligently retrieve and utilize Workspace data. You will lead the future of Search across our suite of applications, including Gmail, Drive, Chat, Calendar and others. You will build products powering AI\-motivated experiences like Gmail AI Overview Optimization (AIO), Drive AIO, Docs Help Me Write and many others.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager — Customer & Delivery
jobs.description:
**The Role, in One Sentence**
 You own the bridge between Customer Success and Engineering — making sure engineering builds what customers can actually use, and making sure customers understand, adopt, and champion what gets built.
   

  

**The Three Metrics You Will Be Measured On**
**Product usage — are customers actually using the modules they pay for**
**Product champions — are there named people inside our accounts who advocate for us**
**Recurring revenue — retention and expansion, as an outcome of the first two**
 Everything below serves these three. If an activity doesn't move one of them, it isn't the job.
   

  

**What This Job Actually Is**
 Read this section carefully. It is the most important part of this posting.
   

  

 What It Means Day to Day
   

  

 \~40% Product
   

  

 Owning the roadmap for existing modules. Prioritisation. Writing specs. Relentlessly simplifying — fewer clicks, less jargon, usable by a 55\-year\-old warden and a 19\-year\-old student alike. Deciding what does not get built.
   

  

 \~30% Engineering \& Delivery
   

  

 Sprint planning, grooming, scope management, release coordination, UAT, post\-release verification. Working daily with our Tech Lead and engineering team.
   

  

 \~30% Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

 Product demos. Feature training. Webinars. Roadmap sessions that get customers excited about what's coming. Gathering requirements first\-hand rather than second\-hand.
   

  

 Travel is occasional, not routine. Most customer work is remote. Expect on\-site visits some months and none in others.
   

  

**What This Job Is Not**
* Not account management. We have a Customer Success team. They own accounts, escalations, support tickets, and day\-to\-day service. You do not.
* Not a growth role. There is no funnel to optimise, no experimentation programme, no PLG motion. If your last three years were Mixpanel dashboards and A/B tests, this will make you unhappy within six months.
* Not pure product, not pure engineering. You will not sit in Figma all day, and you will not be writing code. You will spend your time translating in both directions — and the translation is the value.


**What You Will Own**
 Product
   

  

* Roadmap for existing modules — user management, leave and attendance, tickets and assets, mess, amenities, checklists, visitor management, finance, notifications
* Prioritisation across competing asks from Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering
* Simplification as a discipline. Our users are not software people. When engineering ships something in six clicks, your job is to ask why it isn't three. When a screen uses internal terminology, your job is to catch it before a customer does.
* Saying no — to customers, to Sales, and to engineering — with a reason that holds
* Protecting the roadmap from one\-off customisations that fork the product


 Delivery
   

  

* Sprint planning, grooming, and release coordination with the Tech Lead and engineering team
* Turning requirements into specs engineering can act on, with the "why" intact
* UAT and post\-release verification — confirming it works for the customer, not just in staging
* Never committing a date engineering hasn't agreed to


 Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

* Product demos that make non\-technical institutional buyers want the product
* Training existing customers on new features so they actually get adopted
* Webinars and roadmap sessions across the customer base
* Building product champions inside accounts — the people who will renew and expand us
* First\-hand requirement gathering, so we aren't building from a game of telephone


 Systems, Not Heroics
   

  

* Every commitment logged. No verbal promises that live only in your head.
* Building the process so it runs without founder involvement.


**Must\-Haves**
* 3\+ years of full\-time product management, post\-graduation, with real ownership specs, prioritisation, sprints, releases.
* Demonstrable ability to run an excellent product demo to a non\-technical audience. This is tested, not taken on trust.
* Experience with external paying customers. Internal\-platform\-only PMs do not fit — you need to have built for people who could leave.
* Sprint ownership: planning, grooming, scope, release. Not "worked alongside a Scrum Master."
* A demonstrated instinct for simplification an example where you removed steps, jargon or complexity from a product and can explain what it did to adoption.
* Requirements ownership: you have interrogated a request, not transcribed it.
* Written English strong enough to send an email to a university Dean without review.
* Bengaluru\-based or genuinely relocating. This is an onsite role.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Education, EdTech, campus, or institutional software
* Products used by low\-digital\-literacy or non\-technical user bases
* Experience running customer webinars, training programmes, or feature\-adoption campaigns


 Explicitly Not Required
   

  

 Mixpanel
   

  

* Amplitude
* A/B testing
* funnel and cohort analytics
* PLG
* SQL
* growth experimentation
* consumer product background.


 These will not improve your candidacy. Their absence will not hurt it.
   

  

 Skills: edtech,customer engagement,sprint planning

jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
===============

  

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.


\&\#xa;
**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.


**What will you contribute?**
-----------------------------

  

Reporting to the **Director, Product Management** , the **Senior Product Manager** will collaborate with the Development and Product Management teams on product requirements, design, documentation, and risk mitigation strategies. Participate in business case development, market research, and competitive intelligence analysis. Develop business requirements and collaborate in the translation of business requirements into technical requirements. Define system and functional requirements.


**Responsibilities \& Deliverables:**  

  

Your deliverables as a **Senior Product Manager** will include, but are not limited to, the following:


* Creates recommendations and feature definition to address market opportunities.
* Gathers information from stakeholders to document functional, system, and/or data requirements.
* Perform product system impact analysis to determine affected functional areas of the application.
* Collaborates with team members to create detailed functional and/or technical specifications for complex development of new or modifications to existing applications or systems. May review requirements developed by other staff and provide guidance to improve requirement quality as necessary.
* Collaborates with team members in the development of specifications to create unit and integrated test cases.
* Assists in the analysis of results of unit and integration testing.
* Provides overall direction for product enhancements and general product development requirements.
* Serves as a liaison between internal and external stakeholders
* Collaborates with technical communications writer to develop proper and thorough documentation (internal and external) describing product changes as appropriate.

* Identifies training needs and designs, and trains employees on product usage and new features/functionality.
* Provides direction to less skilled employees in business systems analysis concepts. May design and implement training plans.
* Identifies continuous improvement opportunities for Product Management processes.
* May act as a team lead for project work and facilitate meetings, webinars, and focus groups.
* Assist in release preparation duties including release notes, bulletins, and/or supporting documentation.

**Required Experience:**

* Financial industry experience preferred.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong technical, analytical, and development skills including the ability to provide solutions to a variety of business problems of complex scope and complexity.
* Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills required.
* Ability to mentor less experienced analysts.
* Advanced facilitation skills to conduct and facilitate focused requirements analysis discussions.
* Ability to work independently or within a team environment and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to organize and lead others in accomplishing project goals and objectives.
* Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle.
* Advanced knowledge of defining system and functional requirements.
We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:


**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.


**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

jobs.title: Ralph Lauren Business Analyst, Microsoft 365
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands. At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Ralph Lauren is seeking a Business Analyst to support our Digital Workplace platforms, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive. This role is responsible for gathering and analyzing business requirements, supporting platform operations, coordinating issue resolution, and driving business process improvements across Microsoft 365 solutions. The Business Analyst will work closely with Technology, Corporate Communications, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, define solutions, manage operational support, and ensure business needs are successfully delivered.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Business Analysis, Governance \& Documentation
* Gather, analyze, document, and prioritize business requirements for Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Digital Workplace initiatives.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, pain points, and operational needs.
* Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and solution recommendations.
* Create and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), workflow diagrams, process maps, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and other business documentation.
* Perform gap analysis and identify opportunities to improve business processes, automate workflows, standardize operations, and enhance the overall user experience.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), develop test scenarios, validate business requirements, and support release readiness and business adoption activities.
* Manage requirement changes throughout the project lifecycle and ensure traceability from business requirements through implementation.
* Support SharePoint governance initiatives, including site lifecycle management, permissions, content governance, information architecture, and compliance with organizational standards.
* Document business processes, operational procedures, system configurations, issue resolutions, and platform enhancements to support ongoing operations and knowledge sharing.
* Create and maintain knowledge articles, end\-user documentation, and internal support materials to promote consistent processes and improve user adoption 2\) Support activities
* Manage and support ServiceNow incidents, service requests, and operational tickets related to Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Track, prioritize, and manage work items, enhancements, defects, and project tasks using Jira.
* Monitor support queues and ensure timely resolution of issues while meeting SLA expectations.
* Support SharePoint site administration, permissions management, access requests, and governance activities.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, security, application support, and vendor teams to resolve business and operational issues.
* Perform impact analysis for production issues and proposed platform changes.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and user satisfaction.
* Assist with platform upgrades, feature rollouts, and change implementations.


**Experience, Skills \& Knowledge**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst supporting Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, or Digital Workplace platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, and related collaboration technologies.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, business process analysis, user stories, functional specifications, and process documentation.
* Experience coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validating business solutions.
* Experience managing incidents, service requests, and operational support using ServiceNow.
* Hands\-on experience using Jira for backlog management, issue tracking, Agile projects, and sprint planning.
* Understanding of SharePoint governance, permissions, site administration, and Microsoft 365 best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
* Experience working in enterprise, cross\-functional environments and collaborating with both business and technical teams

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Business Analyst / Project Manager at** 
 Samanvay
 **for Avni Platform** 

**Location:** 

 Bengaluru (Work from Office)
 




**Experience:** 

 3\-5 years in an Analyst or Sales role
 




**Compensation:** 

 ₹10\-₹12 LPA depending on the expertise
 




  




**Build one platform. Solve problems across many sectors.** 


 At Samanvay, we believe technology should make frontline work simpler, smarter and more effective.
 




  






 Our flagship product, Avni, is an open\-source, offline\-first platform that enables nonprofits, governments and social enterprises to digitise field programmes and make better decisions using data.
 




  






 Imagine building a platform where the same feature could help a community health worker identify high\-risk pregnancies, a teacher monitor student learning, a field engineer inspect water infrastructure, or a nonprofit support livelihood programmes—all without changing the underlying product. That’s Avni.
 




  






 Unlike most enterprise software, Avni is designed for environments where internet connectivity is unreliable, workflows are constantly evolving, and users have varying levels of digital familiarity.
 




  






 Some of the people who use Avni every day are experienced clinicians. Others are community volunteers or frontline workers who are using a smartphone for the first time as part of their work. Designing software that works beautifully for all of them is one of our biggest engineering challenges—and one of the reasons our work is so rewarding.
 




  






 We don’t build custom applications for every programme. We build one configurable platform that powers healthcare, education, nutrition, livelihoods, water management, climate resilience and community development. Every capability you build has the potential to unlock entirely new use cases.
 




  






 We're looking for a
 
**Business Analyst / Project Manager** 

 who enjoys solving complex problems, working closely with customers, and transforming ideas into successful digital solutions. If you're someone who thrives on bringing clarity to ambiguity, keeping projects on track, and building strong relationships with customers and engineering teams, we'd love to hear from you.
 





 This is a role for someone who enjoys taking ownership—from understanding a customer's challenges to ensuring a solution is delivered successfully. You'll work closely with nonprofits and governments, collaborate with experienced product and engineering teams, and play a key role in delivering software that makes a meaningful social impact.
 





 Learn more:
 
 https://samanvayfoundation.org
 



  




**What You'll Be Doing** 


 As a Business Analyst / Project Manager, you'll own the complete implementation journey—from discovery to delivery.
 




 Understand the Customer
 
* Facilitate discovery workshops to understand customer goals, processes, and operational challenges.
* Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, workflows, and user stories.
* Recommend practical solutions using the Avni platform.



 Lead Successful Implementations
 
* Plan project timelines, milestones, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate closely with customers, developers, QA, and product teams.
* Track progress, manage dependencies, and proactively resolve risks to keep projects moving.
* Project Scope Management
* Handling change requests
* Ensure implementations are delivered on time and meet agreed quality standards.



 Build Strong Customer Relationships
 
* Be the trusted point of contact throughout the project.
* Keep stakeholders informed with timely, clear, and transparent communication.
* Facilitate meetings, document decisions, and ensure action items are followed through to completion.
* Build confidence through reliability, responsiveness, and ownership.



 Improve the Product
 
* Bring customer insights back to the product team.
* Work with engineering to shape platform improvements and new features.
* Support UAT, user training, go\-live, and transition to support.


**We're Looking For Someone Who** 
* Takes ownership and follows through on commitments.
* Experience working in Agile Methodology \& T\&M projects
* Experience in Change Management
* Is highly organised and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Communicates clearly, confidently, and proactively.
* Enjoys working with both customers and technical teams.
* Thinks analytically and solves problems with a practical mindset.
* Has exceptional attention to detail and values high\-quality documentation.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment where every project makes a real difference.


**Why You'll Love Working Here** 
* Be part of a mission\-driven organisation where your work has a visible, measurable impact on the communities our partners serve..
* Build technology that creates real\-world social impact, helping frontline workers and organisations improve the lives of millions of people.
* Own projects end\-to\-end—from understanding customer needs to delivering successful implementations.
* Collaborate with an experienced product, engineering, and implementation team while working with diverse stakeholders across the social sector.
* Gain exposure to the nonprofit ecosystem, understanding how organisations design, implement, and measure impactful programs.


**Apply** 

  






 If this sounds like the kind of engineering challenge you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you.
 




  






 📧
 
 careers@samanvayfoundation.org

 IT

 Full\-time
